summary_zh: 普利策奖得主、畅销书《习惯的力量》作者 Charles Duhigg 揭示伟大对话背后的科学：从 FBI 谈判专家到"有效怀疑"问题（Loch Ness 调查、海恩尼斯总统刺杀案），掌握"动机性访谈"四步法能让任何对话从对抗走向合作——核心是不要问对方想要什么，而要问他们认为自己想要什么。
summary_en: Pulitzer-winning Smarter Faster Better author Charles Duhigg unpacks the science of better conversations—from FBI hostage negotiators to the "effective skepticism" of the Loch Ness investigation and the JFK assassination. His four-step "motivational interviewing" loop turns any confrontation into collaboration: don't ask what someone wants, ask what they think they want.
